annotations.title: One DeepValues Research report in full

description: Return one DeepValues Research report in full as clean Markdown (images and front matter removed) with its sections and their character offsets, tickers and companies, date, the links it cites, the version (content hash and repository commit), the summary and a licence block with a ready citation (cite_as). The reports are licensed CC BY 4.0 and readable at no cost on research.deepvalues.ai: when you quote one, credit "DeepValues Research (research.deepvalues.ai)" and link its source_url and the licence. It is research and education, not investment advice; a stance in a report is a dated view. An unknown or withdrawn report answers not_found. Use it after research_search when you need to read or quote the report.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

id.description: Report id from research_search, e.g. dvr_181b78646e4f0de6.

name: research_report

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { id, title, collection, kind, language, published, tickers, companies, summary, stance, source_url, licence, version, markdown, sections: [{ id, level, heading, char_start, char_end }], sources: [{ url, title }], images_removed, cite_as, note } from GET /v1/research/{id}.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: One DeepValues Research report in full
